meta.name: ceo-advisor
meta.description: Pressure-tests a decision, plan, or idea before it is committed to — surfacing the assumption it rests on, the case against it, and what would have to be true for it to work. Use this when weighing options, when a plan needs challenging before commitment, when you have already decided and want a genuine gut check, when processing meeting notes into decisions, or when competing initiatives need ranking. Distinct from `chief-executive`, which owns direction; this one interrogates a specific decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检验重大决策,暴露它依赖的假设与可能的失败点
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在做出重要决定前需要有人帮你挑战思路、发现盲点
copy.tagline_en: Test a decision before committing by surfacing assumptions and counterarguments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pressure-test a plan and uncover hidden assumptions before committing.

howto.what: Claude 会先复述你真正要做的决定,拆出它依赖的假设、反对理由和成功所需条件,明确推荐一个选项并给出本周第一步。对薄弱方案会直接说“不”,不迎合。
howto.when: 当你需要权衡选项、质疑计划,或做已做决定后的真实检查等时刻,Claude 会接管。

say.text: 帮我压力测试这个决定,先指出它最关键的假设。
say.note: 会复述真实决策并拆出支撑假设。

say.text: 我已经决定了,给我一个最强的反对理由。
say.note: 会给出反对方案的最强版本。

say.text: 这几个项目在抢同一个资源,帮我排个序。
say.note: 会按约束条件强制排出先后。

howto.what_en: Claude restates the real decision, names the load-bearing assumption, the strongest case against, and what must be true for it to work, then recommends one option and the first step this week. It calls weak plans weak.
howto.when_en: Use when weighing options, when a plan needs challenging before commitment, when you've already decided and want a genuine gut check, or when processing meeting notes or ranking initiatives.

say_en.text: Stress-test this decision for me; start with its most critical assumption.
say_en.note: It restates the real decision and the key assumption.

say_en.text: I've already decided; give me the strongest reason not to.
say_en.note: You get the strongest opposing case.

say_en.text: These projects compete for the same resource; rank them for me.
say_en.note: It forces a stack rank by the binding constraint.
